segments.title: Why are Komodo teeth ORANGE?
segments.say: Komodo dragon teeth have orange tips. Why? Blood, iron, or rust from food? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's IRON!
segments.say: It's iron! A thin coat on the tips and edges.

segments.title: Keeps them razor-sharp
segments.say: The iron helps keep the teeth razor sharp. Perfect for tearing prey.

segments.title: Never seen in a reptile before
segments.say: Scientists had never seen this in a meat eating reptile before.
